description: Resize any image to exact pixel dimensions with an aspect-ratio lock, quick presets and percentage scaling. Preview the result and download as PNG, JPG or WebP.

faqs.a: Yes — “Lock aspect ratio” is on by default. Change either the width or the height and the other updates automatically so the image never stretches.
The pixel dimensions always change. The file size usually shrinks when you downscale, but upscaling or choosing PNG can make it larger.
faqs.q: Does resizing reduce the file size?

faqs.a: No. Everything is drawn on a canvas in your browser — your image is never uploaded anywhere.

howto: Choose an image — its current dimensions appear automatically.
Type the new width and height (aspect ratio stays locked unless you untick it), or tap a preset like 1920px, 1280px, 50% or 25%.
Pick an output format (PNG, JPG or WebP) and set quality for JPG/WebP.
Click “Resize image”, preview the result and download it.
title: Image Resizer
